english.title: Use a motor vehicle / trailer with tyre with any of the ply / cord exposed
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer]_

when the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL POSITION..) wheel was fitted with a pneumatic tyre which had the ply or cord exposed
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(1)(e) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used

(A)_[a motor vehicle **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[a trailer]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL POSITION..) of the vehicle was fitted with a tyre which had the ply or cord exposed.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale for goods vehicles or vehicles adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
